description: This Java class 'StartupControlPanel' manages the startup and shutdown procedures for the OFBiz server, including initialization, container loading, shutdown hooks, and system termination.

classes.name: StartupControlPanel
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to control OFBiz server lifecycle, including init, start, shutdown, and termination.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes OFBiz by setting system properties and creating a configuration object based on startup commands.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes the startup sequence, including log directory creation, optional shutdown hook registration, container loading, and optional shutdown after load.

methods.name: fullyTerminateSystem
methods.description: Handles fatal startup exceptions by printing stack trace and terminating the JVM with exit code 1.

methods.name: shutdownServer
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the server by unloading containers and updating server state.

methods.name: loadGlobalOfbizSystemProperties
methods.description: Loads system properties from a specified properties file.

methods.name: createLogDirectoryIfMissing
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: loadContainers
methods.description: Loads server containers and updates server state to RUNNING.
